title: Format repository info from API data
instruction: Define a function `format_repo_info(repo_data)` that takes a dictionary with repository data (containing at least "name" and "stargazers_count" keys) and returns a formatted string: `Repository: [name], Stars: [count]`.

title: Extract repo info to JSON
instruction: Define a function `extract_repo_json(repo_data)` that takes a dictionary with repository data (containing at least "name" and "description" keys) and returns a pretty-printed JSON string (indent=2) with just the "name" and "description" fields.
test_suite:
import json

def test_typical_repo():
    data = {"name": "cpython", "description": "The Python programming language", "stargazers_count": 60000}
    result = exercise.extract_repo_json(data)
    parsed = json.loads(result)
    assert parsed["name"] == "cpython", f"Expected name 'cpython', got {parsed['name']!r}"
    assert parsed["description"] == "The Python programming language", f"Expected description, got {parsed['description']!r}"
    assert "stargazers_count" not in parsed, f"Should not include extra fields, got {list(parsed.keys())}"
    assert result.count("\n") >= 2, f"Expected pretty-printed JSON (newlines), got {result!r}"

def test_null_description():
    data = {"name": "empty-repo", "description": None}
    result = exercise.extract_repo_json(data)
    parsed = json.loads(result)
    assert parsed["name"] == "empty-repo", f"Expected name, got {parsed['name']!r}"
    assert parsed["description"] is None, f"Expected None description, got {parsed['description']!r}"

def test_different_repo():
    data = {"name": "pandas", "description": "Data analysis library"}
    result = exercise.extract_repo_json(data)
    parsed = json.loads(result)
    assert parsed["name"] == "pandas", f"Expected name 'pandas', got {parsed['name']!r}"
    assert parsed["description"] == "Data analysis library", f"Expected description, got {parsed['description']!r}"
